title: Disney's first CTO led an AI startup it once accused of copying its characters | TechCrunch
summary: Disney previously claimed that the company was hosting copyrighted characters from its franchises. Variety reports that Anand was chosen for the role by new Disney CEO Josh D’Amaro, who took over after former company chief Bob Iger stepped down in March.
